terms.body: The city where the government office of a prefecture (Tokyo Metropolis, Hokkaido, Osaka and Kyoto, or a prefecture) is located.
One of the 8 groups Japan is divided into: Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki, Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu.
The city where a country's government is located and that is the center of the country.
One of the 6 huge pieces of land: Eurasia, Africa, North America, South America, Australia and Antarctica.
An important natural place or building that UNESCO has chosen so that people around the world will protect it.
A craft made by hand with old skills and materials, and designated by the national government.
A dish made with foods from a certain area that people have eaten there for a long time.
The line at 0 degrees latitude that goes all the way around the Earth, exactly halfway between the North Pole and the South Pole.
The line at 0 degrees longitude that passes through London, England.
The three biggest oceans of the world: the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.
